generalAbilities.name: Sportlebore Infestation
generalAbilities.description:
Saving Throw Basic DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 1 (1 hour)

Stage 3 Enfeebled 2 (1 hour)

Stage 4 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save) as the host painfully vomits out a sportlebore swarm and returns to stage 1

defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

defensiveAbilities.name: Pour Down Throat
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature in the sportlebore swarm's area speaks, uses a verbal component, or opens its mouth

Effect A portion of the sportlebore swarm attempts to surge down the throat of the triggering creature, which must attempt a DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature gets a mouthful of sportlebores. It spits the insects out and avoids further damage, but it can't speak for 1 round, and if it was performing a verbal spellcasting action, the spell fails and the caster wastes the action.

Failure The creature takes 4d6 Piercing Damage damage from sportlebore bites, can't speak for 1 round, and loses a spell as noted under Success.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also exposed to sportlebore infestation.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming Bites
offensiveAbilities.description: Each creature in the sportlebore swarm's area takes 4d6 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save).
